import json, subprocess, sys
def run(obj):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","submission/main.py"],input=json.dumps(obj).encode(),capture_output=True)
    return json.loads(p.stdout.decode())

def mk(ping2):
    return {"version":1,"n":4,"capacity":[3,3,3,3],
      "edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
               {"u":0,"v":2,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
               {"u":2,"v":1,"ping_us":ping2,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
               {"u":1,"v":3,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"b"}],
      "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":30,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,
                 "drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}

for ping2 in (1,5):
    o=run(mk(ping2))
    print("=== ping2=%d"%ping2)
    print(" rounds:", json.dumps(o["rounds"],separators=(",",":")))
    print(" metrics:", json.dumps(o["metrics"],separators=(",",":")))
    print(" classes:", json.dumps(o["classes"],separators=(",",":")))
    print(" summary:", json.dumps(o["summary"],separators=(",",":")))
PYEOF
